causes.detail: Sticky manufacturing/assembly residue obstructing wastegate solenoid valve (HELLA documented scenario)
Vacuum/pressure connections, electrical supply or genuine boost problem, verify independently

diagnostic_steps: Check both P0234 and co-occurring P0299 and note module/conditions
Inspect turbocharger control solenoid, hoses, connectors and actuation
Check for sticky residue at solenoid steel nozzle per HELLA procedure
If defective, HELLA cites replacement GM 55574902 / part 8 50 350 for this context; confirm by VIN before fitting
Clear code, road test and verify measured boost actual vs target against matching specifications
parts: Turbo control solenoid GM 55574902 only after VIN matching
